snippet_primary: "When you purchase USPS shipping labels for your Etsy packages, you may receive discounted volume shipping rates. Aside from Etsy's standard fees, there are no additional membership fees to use shipping labels purchased on Etsy."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states USPS shipping labels purchased on Etsy may qualify for discounted volume rates, with no additional membership fees beyond standard Etsy fees
